query: How does resolution time vary across issue themes, channel, and priority?

per_column.name: issue_theme
per_column.rationale: The query explicitly asks how resolution time varies across 'issue themes', which are not present in the original columns (only free-text issue_description). This column supplies exactly the missing grouping axis, giving genuine analytical leverage to compare resolution_minutes across themes alongside channel and priority. Values are sound categorisations of the source text: CS-0001 (duplicate invoice line item) -> Billing/Pricing; CS-0002 (session drops / SSO) -> Authentication; CS-0003 (502 gateway outage) -> Infrastructure/Outage; CS-0004 (pin favourite reports enhancement) -> Feature Request are all well grounded. CS-0005 (stray BOM breaking Snowflake ingestion) as 'Integration' is defensible though arguably Data/Export-related; still a reasonable reading. A sensible 'Other' bucket handles ambiguous rows. No invented facts observed.

judge.rationale: The single added column directly instantiates the 'issue theme' dimension named in the query, derived from otherwise unstructured issue_description text, providing a real new axis to group and compare resolution time. Sampled values are faithful, warranted categorisations of the source text with no hallucinated specifics; one borderline case (BOM/export labelled Integration) is a minor interpretive stretch rather than an unsupported assertion.
